def left_rotate(n: int, d: int) -> int:
    """Rotate a 32-bit integer n left by d bits."""
    d %= 32
    return ((n << d) | (n >> (32 - d))) & 0xFFFFFFFF


# Example calls:
# left_rotate(16, 2) == 64
# left_rotate(0b10000000000000000000000000000001, 1) == 0b00000000000000000000000000000011
